name: Input tokens served from Gemini's cache
description:
Shows: Daily input tokens on chat spans against the part Gemini served from its implicit cache (gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens), by agent.
Why it matters: Cached input is billed at a fraction of the price, so a high cached share means real cost is lower than the paid-spend estimate (which prices cache reads at full price). Keeping prompts stable raises the share and lowers cost.
